flare-redact.description: Built to redact secrets and personal data from text at runtime. Run secrets-only here: its personal-data and generic-assignment detectors are off.
outOfScope: Personal-data detectors and generic_assignment: disabled for this run.
The Python and Rust engines: not published to a registry, so not measured; the JavaScript engine only.

gitleaks.description: Built to find secrets in git history, files and directories before they are committed.
outOfScope: Git history scanning: only the directory scan of the fixture files is run.
Custom rule files and environment rule overrides: default rules only.

openredaction.description: Built to detect and redact personal data in text. Run at its defaults: every built-in pattern is on, and only its credential patterns map to families here.
outOfScope: Document, CSV, XLSX and OCR processors: not used; the text detect() path only.
Tuning options (categories, patterns, confidence threshold): none applied.
Personal-data detections are reported without a family on credential inputs.

openredaction-credentials.description: The same package restricted to its credentials category. A diagnostic profile with its own configuration identity, never the default result.

openredaction-credential-bearing.description: The same package restricted to the 33 types the audit reads as credential-bearing. A diagnostic profile with its own configuration identity, never the default result.

openredaction-mapped.description: The same package restricted to the types the adapter maps to a family. A diagnostic profile with its own configuration identity, never the default result.

trufflehog.description: Built to find and verify secrets in repositories and other sources. Verification is off here.
outOfScope: Live verification of findings: off, so no network calls are made.
Sources other than a filesystem scan of the fixture files.
